analysis: Nick Bosa is now confirmed OUT multi-week for San Francisco, layering on top of Brock Purdy already sitting out for a 2nd straight week (Mac Jones starting, playing well). Once both injuries are priced in, the model actually flips the spread read: the fair line comes out to roughly SF -6.2, well inside DraftKings own -7.5 and further still from Caesars -7.5 to BookMaker.eus recent -9.0 read. The bigger story is the total -- the model projects 40.7 points combined against a market sitting at 48.0, a 7.3-point gap and the widest of any game on the board this week, with 69% of simulations landing Under.

Arizona is also starting a backup-caliber QB (Jacoby Brissett, not Kyler Murray -- correcting an error carried forward from an earlier cycle that assumed Murray was still on this roster), so neither offense is at full strength. That combination -- two shorthanded offenses, one missing its best pass rusher -- points squarely at a lower-scoring, closer-than-the-number game than the market currently reflects.
